svg.title: Deletion testcross outcomes
svg.desc: A deletion heterozygote crossed to a recessive tester produces intact and deletion-bearing offspring. Eleven separate unreplicated chromosome rods preserve all 57 alleles and both phenotype outcomes. Each pale centromere lies in an unlabeled blue left arm before a. Equal locus pitch and sparse bands are schematic. The deleted homolog lacks c, d and e, shortening the rod by three regions. In the lower offspring those recessive loci are hemizygous, not homozygous. One tester gamete class crosses two parental gamete classes.

g.text: wildtype for a+, b+, and f+;
mutant for c−, d−, and e−
